entities.summary: Glenn Micallef is a Maltese civil servant who was Chief of Staff to the Prime Minister of Malta, Robert Abela, from 2020 to 2024. Since December 2024 he has served as European Commissioner for Intergenerational Fairness, Youth, Culture and Sport.
